title: Library of Layers (LoL): Adaptively Ordering Transformer Layers at Runtime
abstract: arXiv:2611.03526v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Computer programmers chain together the same reusable computational primitives, for example, conditional statements or loops, but in different orders to implement different algorithms. In contrast, existing language model architectures always execute their layers in the same order. We introduce Library of Layers (LoL), an architecture that dynamically orders its layers during inference to solve the problem at hand. LoL has a single hyperparameter, the size of its global library of transformer blocks, that allows it to transition seamlessly between parameter reuse and sparsity, generalizing the parameter-efficiency and FLOPs-efficiency tradeoffs of dense, depth-recurrent, and mixture of experts architectures in one unified family. We show that LoL achieves competitive performance with all three above baselines when pretrained on text data. translated_title: 层库（LoL）：在运行时自适应地排序Transformer层
translated_abstract: 计算机程序员将相同的可重用计算原语（例如条件语句或循环）以不同的顺序链接在一起，从而实现不同的算法。相比之下，现有的语言模型架构总是以相同的顺序执行其各层。我们提出了层库（Library of Layers，LoL），这是一种在推理过程中动态调整层执行顺序以解决当前问题的架构。LoL只有一个超参数，即其全局Transformer块库的大小，这使其能够在参数重用与稀疏性之间无缝转换，将密集架构、深度循环架构和专家混合架构在参数效率与FLOPs效率上的权衡统一到一个框架家族中。我们证明，在文本数据上进行预训练时，LoL与上述三种基线架构相比均取得了有竞争力的性能。在合成的数独和迷宫数据上，我们观察到该模型针对不同问题采用不同的层排序……（原文摘要不完整）
tldr: 提出层库架构，使模型能在推理时动态调整Transformer层的执行顺序，用一个统一框架同时概括了密集、深度循环和专家混合架构在参数效率与计算效率上的权衡。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Library of Layers (LoL) architecture that dynamically reorders Transformer layers at inference time, unifying the parameter-efficiency and FLOPs-efficiency tradeoffs of dense, depth-recurrent, and mixture-of-experts architectures within a single framework.
